```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(primer.data)
#| message: false
```

```{r}
shaming
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
set.seed(10)

samples <- tibble(replicate = 1:1000) |> 
  mutate(sample = map(replicate, ~ slice_sample(shaming, n = 50))) |> 
  mutate(
    sample_mean = map_dbl(sample, ~ mean(.x$age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sample_se = map_dbl(sample, ~ sd(.x$age, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(.x))),
    lower = sample_mean - 1.96 * sample_se,
    upper = sample_mean + 1.96 * sample_se
  ) |> 
  select(-sample)
```

```{r}
truth <- mean(shaming$age, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(samples$lower < truth & samples$upper > truth)
```

```{r}
samples |> 
  slice(1:100) |> 
  mutate(id = 1:100) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_mean, y = id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = truth, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Confidence Intervals of Sample Means",
    subtitle = "About 95% of the 95% confidence intervals contain the true population mean age (49.8 years)",
    x = "Sample Mean Age (years)",
    y = "Replicate Index",
    caption = "Data source: shaming dataset from primer.data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
set.seed(10)

biased_samples <- tibble(replicate = 1:1000) |> 
  mutate(sample = map(replicate, ~ slice_sample(shaming, n = 50, weight_by = ifelse(age > 40, 3, 1)))) |> 
  mutate(
    sample_mean = map_dbl(sample, ~ mean(.x$age, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sample_se = map_dbl(sample, ~ sd(.x$age, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(nrow(.x))),
    lower = sample_mean - 1.96 * sample_se,
    upper = sample_mean + 1.96 * sample_se
  ) |> 
  select(-sample)
```

```{r}
truth <- mean(shaming$age, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(biased_samples, aes(x = sample_mean)) +
  geom_density(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = truth, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(biased_samples$sample_mean), color = "black", linetype = "solid") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Density of Biased Sample Means",
    x = "Sample Mean Age (years)",
    y = "Density"
  )
```
